caption:
Mr Turtle says he has no time to exercise, yet he walks past a staircase every day.

Climbing stairs works your thighs and glutes with every step, so it can be a handy way to build leg strength into your day.

Hybi's starter plan: hold the rail, place your whole foot on each step, start with 1–2 flights and add one flight a week when it feels easy. Stop and see your GP if you notice chest pain or dizziness.

Knee swelling, unusual breathlessness, or pain lasting more than two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
